summary: Layer 1B expansion for the grid field-services chokepoint found one obvious reference leader and three smaller public companies with direct or adjacent exposure to utility T&D construction, power-delivery services, grid engineering, program administration, and energy-transition technical services. The strongest direct-exposure names are Quanta Services as the reference anchor, plus MYR Group and Primoris as underfollowed mid-cap specialty contractors. Willdan is a less direct but potentially underfollowed grid/utility consulting and program-management candidate that may benefit from planning, optimization, inspection, and utility energy-program bottlenecks rather than physical line crews.
